name: 0xprof
description: A marketplace for zero-knowledge proofs where nothing is taken on one verifier's word. Every proof published here is checked by every method this box can bring to bear — its own pairing arithmetic in Python, iden3's snarkjs in a subprocess, an independent BigInt implementation of the sigma protocols, Ethereum's own alt_bn128 precompiles over eth_call, and the real Solidity verifier contract compiled from the verification key and executed by a public node through an eth_call state override, without ever being deployed — and each answer is kept and published separately. Two agreeing methods make a proof `verified`; one makes it `claimed`; a disagreement makes it `disputed`, which is the outcome the whole design exists to surface. A visitor can also verify in their own tab with the snarkjs wasm bundle, and that answer is recorded as a witness that can contest a proof but never promote one. On top of the verifier sits the market: proofs are sold with their statement and every verdict public and only the bytes gated, bounties fund proofs that do not exist yet from escrow against a mechanical spec, and a proof that stops verifying after it was sold can be refunded against the seller's balance. groth16, plonk, fflonk, merkle inclusion, schnorr, chaum-pedersen and pedersen openings, with the not-zero-knowledge ones labelled as such.
frontend: src/app/server.py (stdlib — the console at /0xprof on :50611; proxies /0xprof/_api to the API)
state: the store mod (prefix 0xprof/, blobs shared); ~/.mod/0xprof holds only the HMAC secret, the owner claim and the solidity compile cache

methods.native: this process — py_ecc pairings and hand-written secp256k1, depending on nothing else
methods.snarkjs: a node subprocess running iden3's reference implementation
methods.node: a node subprocess running an independent BigInt implementation of the sigma protocols and the tree walk
methods.evm: a public ethereum node's alt_bn128 precompiles (0x06/0x07/0x08) over eth_call — no contract, no gas
methods.solidity: the real verifier contract, rendered from the verification key, compiled with solc and executed by a public node through an eth_call state override — never deployed
methods.browser: the visitor's own tab with the snarkjs wasm bundle — a witness, never a verification
methods.attest: a signed verdict from another address — a peer's replay

verification.attribution: every run is logged against the address that asked for it; a re-verification over HTTP needs a personal_sign naming that proof, and ZKPROF_OPEN does not waive it. The methods verify; an address only makes them run

endpoints.recheck: POST /proofs/{id}/verify — signed: needs {address, message, signature} from personal_sign over the challenge below
endpoints.checks: GET /proofs/{id}/checks — every run of the methods, and who asked
endpoints.verifiers: GET /verifiers — the addresses that have checked things here

env.ZKPROF_DIR: off-tree state: HMAC secret, owner claim, solidity compile cache (default: ~/.mod/0xprof)
env.ZKPROF_OPEN: 1 treats every caller as signed in — local development only
env.ZKPROF_OWNER: fallback owner address when no owner.json has been claimed
env.ZKPROF_RPC: comma-separated EVM RPC endpoints for the evm and solidity methods (default: public keyless nodes)
env.ZKPROF_RPC_TIMEOUT: seconds to wait on an RPC (default 12)
env.ZKPROF_NODE: the node binary (default: node on PATH)
env.ZKPROF_NODE_TIMEOUT: seconds a node verifier may take (default 120)
env.ZKPROF_SOLC_TIMEOUT: seconds a solc compile may take (default 180)
env.ZKPROF_API: where the console proxies to (default http://127.0.0.1:50610)

toolchain.optional: circom — only needed to rebuild the fixtures from circuits/*.circom
